coverage.definition: Reviewed generic partial triggers only; unique mechanisms deferred; no percentage target.

ally_combat_buff.rationale: Native friendly unit buff: select an ally with an enemy nearby. Proximity counts are relative to the caster team, not the target team.

aoe.rationale: Native AOE combat action: require at least two candidate enemies inside the runtime native GetAOERadius circle. Unknown/zero radius must not be treated as coverage of geometry or a successful cast.

charged_ally_combat_buff.rationale: Native friendly unit buff: select an ally with an enemy nearby. Proximity counts are relative to the caster team, not the target team. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_aoe.rationale: Native AOE combat action: require at least two candidate enemies inside the runtime native GetAOERadius circle. Unknown/zero radius must not be treated as coverage of geometry or a successful cast. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_dispel_control.rationale: Reviewed strong-dispel/rescue mode: select a controlled ally. is_controlled is an observable status proxy, not proof that every debuff is dispellable. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_execute.rationale: Reviewed finishing spell and native hostile target: reserve it for a low-health opponent. A percentage threshold is not lethal-damage prediction. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_gapclose.rationale: Reviewed offensive movement mode: close a meaningful gap (350–900 units) only with at least 60% self HP. This is not safe-landing/path/terrain prediction. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_healing_ally.rationale: Reviewed healing mode plus native friendly/both unit targeting: choose an ally at or below 80% HP to avoid full-health healing. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_healing_area.rationale: Reviewed team/point healing: choose a wounded allied anchor at or below 80% HP. Native area range still constrains execution. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_healing_self.rationale: Reviewed self or caster-area healing: activate when the caster is at or below 80% HP. This does not optimize healing of the entire team. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_healing_toggle_on.rationale: Reviewed healing toggle: enable for a wounded caster at or below 80% HP with at least 35% mana; the separate off variant stops at 20% mana. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_mana_attack.rationale: Reviewed enemy mana-drain/burn action: avoid an already empty mana pool (target mana at least 20%). Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_mana_restore.rationale: Reviewed native allied mana restoration: select an ally at or below 50% mana. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_offensive_no_target.rationale: Native no-target combat action with damage metadata or reviewed offensive purpose: only activate with an opponent nearby. The 450-unit tactical threshold is editable, not an asserted ability radius. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_offensive_point.rationale: Native point order with hostile team or damage metadata: require an enemy near the caster and anchor the point to a nearby opponent. No trajectory prediction is claimed. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_offensive_unit.rationale: Native hostile unit targeting: select a nearby opponent rather than spending the action without combat context. Native target flags and runtime legality determine invulnerability eligibility. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_offensive_vector.rationale: Reviewed ordinary enemy vector mode: select the nearest legal in-range enemy. Native point start or primary unit uses that anchor; runtime continues caster-to-anchor direction by 150 units. Zero-length direction fails. No vector parameters, landing plan or ricochet-hit prediction. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_protection_ally.rationale: Reviewed protection mode and native friendly/both target: protect the selected recently damaged ally, not an unrelated damaged ally. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_protection_area.rationale: Reviewed point-area protection: anchor the field to a recently damaged ally; native point range still applies. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_protection_self.rationale: Reviewed self-protection: activate after actual recent damage, without predicting incoming projectiles or lethal damage. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_self_combat_buff.rationale: Reviewed ordinary self combat buff: activate only when an enemy is within 800 units; no stance selection or form-specific follow-up actions. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_summon.rationale: Reviewed summon/deploy action with ordinary native casting: summon when an enemy is nearby. Does not issue orders to spawned units or guarantee summon placement. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

charged_time_walk_recovery.rationale: Time Walk recovery mode: at or below 60% self HP, cast at the caster position without an enemy-distance filter. Native Time Walk only restores damage within its backtrack window; this is not a guarantee of healing all missing HP or a safe retreat. Optional variant also requires at least one observed native charge.

toggle_combat_on.rationale: Reviewed combat toggle: enable near an enemy with at least 60% HP; separate off rules handle low HP or disengagement.

toggle_health_off.rationale: Health-draining combat toggle: turn off below 40% HP, with a 60% on threshold to avoid oscillation.

toggle_idle_off.rationale: Disable this combat toggle after enemies leave the 1000-unit vicinity; on uses 800 units.

toggle_off.rationale: Mana-draining toggle: disable at or below 20% self mana. This is a separate rule and is not AND-ed with the on conditions.

toggle_on.rationale: Reviewed mana-draining combat toggle: enable near an enemy with at least 35% mana. The separate off threshold is 20%, leaving a gap to avoid oscillation.

rows.base_description_en:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.

rows.description_cn:
影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。

死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。

After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

rows.base_description_en:
Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy. The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage. The Zealot respawns next to Chen after %zealot_respawn_time%s.

Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a %teleport_delay% second delay. If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.

rows.description_cn:
陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈复活%zealot_respawn_time%秒后在陈身边复活。

狂热者技能可以主动使用，在%teleport_delay%秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。

裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。

途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前死亡了，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
rows.description_en:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.

rows.base_description_en: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.

rows.base_description_en: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%%% for %brewed_up_duration%s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.

rows.description_cn:
酒仙可以根据操控的元素来切换拳法。

每当酒仙施放技能，他都会进入浸酒状态，拳法的威力提升%brewed_up_bonus%%%，持续%brewed_up_duration%秒。如果他在浸酒状态下又施放了技能，持续时间会延长%brewed_up_duration_extend%秒。浸酒状态结束后，他会进入大醉状态，%hangover_time%秒内无法再次进入浸酒状态。

rows.base_description_en:

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds. rows.base_description_en:
After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location. If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead.

Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.

rows.base_description_en: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. mechanisms.mechanism_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.

rows.base_description_en: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.

catalog.summary: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。

rows.base_description_en: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

rows.base_description_en:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

mechanisms.mechanism_cn:
长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。

凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。
mechanisms.mechanism_en:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.

Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.

rows.base_description_en:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.

rows.description_cn:
装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。

凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。

子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。

Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
